ValidationRule.description: this validation rule is used to restrict the acute products to its related facility
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Data_Migration_Check__c.Bypass_Flow_Validations__c = FALSE, RecordType.Name = 'Hospitalization', CONTAINS(Service_Type2__c , "Acute"), Site_Code__c <> "", !ISBLANK(Service_Provided_by_Facility__c), LEFT(Service_Provided_by_Facility__r.Name, LEN(Site_Code__c)) <> Site_Code__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The product must match the facility for Acute healthcare costs.
